text: Raider is down but still on comms. Breathing: yes. Pride: complicated.
Using the backpack as a pillow while waiting for consequences to finish loading.
Downed near the LZ. The shuttle timer is still running, which is either hope or paperwork with engines.
Comms reduced to breathing, static, and one very judgmental backpack buckle.
Raider requested a revive. Signal accounting immediately opened a fresh invoice.
Attempted to negotiate with the floor for a less judgmental angle. Floor countered with gravel.
Permit Choir put the revive request on hold. The hold music is just someone stamping forms off-beat.
Coupon Baron offered 5 percent off emergency extraction if paid in pre-disaster confidence.
Locker Philosopher on comms says lying still is tactical. Clarified this is not the preferred form.
HushTone emergency whisper mode activated and loudly announced your exact distress coordinates.
Promised the Snack Shrine Custodians you would be kinder to rations if this works out.
Exit Strategy Unlimited map says nearest safe route is six meters left and several life choices ago.
A Staycation camper waved from a polite distance and called this a tactical rest interval.
The Breach echoed your breathing back at you with better rhythm and worse bedside manner.
